description: This file contains documentation about implementing OAuth2 with JWT tokens, password hashing, and security best practices in a FastAPI application. It covers concepts such as JWT, password hashing algorithms, token generation, validation, and OAuth2 scopes, providing guidance and technical details for secure authentication.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Pydantic model for access token response containing the token string.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Generates a hashed password from a plaintext password using pwdlib.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored hash.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with an expiration time, including user data.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token to retrieve the current authenticated user.
